Masashi Hirose (Japanese: 広瀬正志 Hirose Masashi) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Hirose was born on November 6, 1947, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He first provided the voice of Poké Ball smith Kurt in of the . He then returned during , voicing character of the day Professor Malveaux. Hirose is currently affiliated with the talent agency .
